summary.text: Staci Czar is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 56 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Steve Baker.
She won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary over Mitch Mullvain, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as operations manager.

paragraphs.text: Czar attended Belton High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in District 56 for 40 years, has been married for 30 years, and has three daughters.
Czar named affordability among her key messages and said she wants to end school vouchers.
She also said she wants to protect unions and keep Missouri from becoming a right-to-work state.
